results.comment: Refresh was tapped after observing status “PERMANENTLY_DENIED: Continue without location or open Settings.” The refreshed status was exactly “GRANTED: Location feature is available.” Use location feature was then tapped; the status became exactly “GRANTED: Location feature used successfully.” A fresh layout was returned with interactive controls still present, confirming the fixture remained responsive.
